# utils

**In one sentence:** Plain helpers for the Upscale Review screen: which decisions an image may get, how to group images into size tiers, and how to format sizes for display.

## Why it exists
The rules about which images may be upscaled or cleaned up are shared by the cards, the detail panel and the per-tier buttons. Keeping them here in one place means every part of the screen applies the same rules.

## What's inside
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `decisions.js` | `UPSCALE_DECISIONS` (`upscale`, `cleanup` = JPEG to PNG at the same size, `skip`). `canUpscale` (the shortest side is below `target`), `decisionsFor(item)` (only the decisions allowed for that image), `normalizeUpscaleDecision`, and the two tier presets `upscaleAllDecision` and `keepSizeDecision`. `optionForUpscaleDecision` returns the option for a decision so its label can be shown. |
| `tiers.js` | `groupByTier(items)` groups images by their `tier_lo`/`tier_hi` shortest-side range, smallest first, with unknown sizes last. `formatTier` gives a label like "512–767px" or "Unknown size". |
| `format.js` | Display text: `formatDimensions` ("1024x768"), `formatPx` ("512px" / "n/a"), and `formatDecisionAction`, which describes the planned action in words. |

## How it works
- An image may be offered `upscale` only if its shortest side is below the target size. It may be offered `cleanup` only if it is a JPEG. `skip` is always allowed.
- `normalizeUpscaleDecision` checks a value in this order: the value itself if allowed, then the image's `initial_decision`, then the first allowed option.
- "Keep size" turns a JPEG into `cleanup` and anything else into `skip`. "Upscale all" turns each image into `upscale` where allowed, and otherwise uses the "keep size" choice.

## Who uses it
- `../upscale_review.js`, `../components/card.js`, `../components/detail.js`, `../components/tier_section.js`.
- Tests: `tests/ui/static/upscale_review.test.js`.
- The tier fields come from Python: `prepare_lora_kit/steps/upscale/step.py` and `prepare_lora_kit_ui/runner/interactions.py` (`upscale_review`).
